buildReceipt.scope: Input/artifact receipt after successful Gradle build; verify again before launch and after the study. Not a replacement for original outcome verification.

checks: External OTB boxes plus source-only AI visibility frozen through actual import controls before each tracking task. Labels never enter tracking. Existing legacy-flow default remains selected initially.

Four actual Java runs: three candidate sources and the simpler default on Jogging1. Every tracker/filter frame equals frozen standalone evidence; independent host overlap and distractor arithmetic match. Native world remains unchanged.

Source overlays, hidden/partial states and recovery results displayed at1100/1600 without page overflow. Label and audit exports match their immutable records; exact label reimport preserves identity.
Abrupt owned-Java termination and cold restart retain all four original runs, labels, association proofs and untouched native world. Reopening actual saved comparison recomputes the same result.

input.provenance: Original OTB target boxes; first-image box alone initializes tracker. Source-only AI visibility review before any evaluation outputs, with external target/other boxes overlaid for identity. No independent human visibility adjudication. MATLAB one-based XYWH converted to normalized corners, clipped to image. Full Jogging temporal extent sampled every4 images; first476 Lemming images sampled every5. Small visible remnants count partial, not fully occluded.
